title: Entity Definition Schema
description: YAML-driven entity definition schema for NetYamlForge. AI: Before modifying YAML, consult docs/examples/ for correct patterns.

imports.description: Other YAML files to import/merge. Use relative paths from the project root.

entities.description: Map of entity name (PascalCase) to entity definition.

additionalProperties.description: Single entity definition. See docs/examples/03-add-new-entity.md for full example.

table.description: CRITICAL: The actual DB table name. Must match the database exactly. Do NOT rename without migrating the DB schema.

key.description: Primary key column name (single key). Use 'keys' for composite keys.

keys.description: Composite primary key column names. Use only when the table has a multi-column PK.

displayName.description: Human-readable entity name (English). Use displayNameI18n for multi-language support.

displayNameKey.description: i18n resource key for the display name. Mutually exclusive with displayName.

displayNameI18n.description: Multi-language display names keyed by culture code (e.g. en-US, ja-JP, zh-CN, ko-KR).

softDelete.description: If true, DELETE becomes UPDATE SET is_deleted=1, and all SELECTs add WHERE is_deleted=0. Requires an 'is_deleted' INTEGER column in the DB table.

isPublic.description: If true, the entity list/detail is accessible without authentication.

pdfTemplate.description: PDF template name (without .yaml extension) in the project's pdf-templates/ directory. Adds a PDF button to each list row.

joins.description: LEFT/INNER JOIN definitions. Always use 'alias' and reference it in column 'expression' fields.

alias.description: SQL alias for the joined table. Required when the same table is joined more than once.

on.description: JOIN ON clause. Use table/alias prefixes on all column names to avoid ambiguity. Example: 'customer.country_id = c.id'

type.description: JOIN type: 'left' (default), 'inner', or 'right'. Use 'inner' only when the joined row is guaranteed to exist.

columns.description: READ-TIME configuration: controls list display, search, and sort. Does NOT control form fields (use 'forms' for that). See docs/examples/01-add-simple-column.md.

type.description: Column data type. Drives input widget type and value parsing.

expression.description: SQL expression override. Use for computed or joined columns. Allowed chars: alphanumeric, dot, space, comma, parentheses, operators. Example: "c.country_name" or "firstName || ' ' || lastName"

searchable.description: If true, this column is included in the global search.

sortable.description: If false, disables sorting for this column. Recommended false for joined/computed columns.

foreignKey.description: Makes this column a FK lookup. The referenced entity must exist in YAML.

entity.description: Referenced entity name (PascalCase, must exist in YAML).

displayColumn.description: Column from referenced entity to display. Defaults to 'id' if omitted.

forms.description: WRITE-TIME configuration: controls which fields appear in create/edit forms. Separate from 'columns'. See docs/examples/01-add-simple-column.md.

fields.description: Fields to include in the create form. Do NOT include the primary key (auto-generated).
Fields to include in the edit form.

filters.description: Filter controls shown above the list. Each key becomes a query string parameter.

column.description: DB column name to filter on.

type.description: Filter input type. Maps to a UI control in _FilterControl.cshtml. Common values: string, like, dropdown, boolean, enum, date, datetime, date-range, range, checkbox, multi-select, entity-picker, entity-multi-picker, toggle-group, bool-toggle. Column types (int, decimal, email, etc.) are also accepted as input type hints.

values.description: For type=enum: list of selectable values.

hooks.description: Hook names to execute at CRUD lifecycle points. Use names from docs/COMMON_HOOKS.md. Do NOT invent new names here — implement IEntityHook in code first. See docs/examples/02-add-validation-hook.md and docs/examples/05-add-custom-hook.md. Keys use camelCase (beforeCreate, afterCreate, beforeUpdate, afterUpdate, beforeDelete, afterDelete). 'presets' defines reusable hook lists referenced via '@presetName'.

presets.description: Named hook lists that can be referenced via '@presetName' in other hook arrays.

beforeCreate.description: Hooks run before INSERT. Executed in order. Any hook can abort the operation. Common values: trim, validate_email, validate_required, validate_unique, validate_range, now.

beforeDelete.description: Hooks run before DELETE (or soft-delete UPDATE).

afterCreate.description: Hooks run after INSERT (within same transaction). Common values: audit_log, webhook, update_count.

afterUpdate.description: Hooks run after UPDATE (within same transaction).

afterDelete.description: Hooks run after DELETE (within same transaction).

confirmation.description: Confirmation dialog settings for create/update operations.

links.description: Navigation link definitions shown in the entity detail view.

layout.description: UI layout overrides (column widths, card mode, etc.).

defaultPageSize.description: Number of rows per page. Default: 20.
